# Recount regions more carefully
from collections import deque

def count_connected_regions(grid, target_color):
    visited = set()
    regions = 0
    for r in range(len(grid)):
        for c in range(len(grid[0])):
            if grid[r][c] == target_color and (r,c) not in visited:
                regions += 1
                # BFS to mark all connected cells
                q = deque([(r,c)])
                while q:
                    cr, cc = q.popleft()
                    if (cr,cc) in visited:
                        continue
                    visited.add((cr,cc))
                    for dr, dc in [(-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)]:
                        nr, nc = cr + dr, cc + dc
                        if 0 <= nr < len(grid) and 0 <= nc < len(grid[0]):
                            if grid[nr][nc] == target_color and (nr,nc) not in visited:
                                q.append((nr,nc))
    return regions

top_regions_4 = count_connected_regions(grid[:13], 4)
